methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from official vendor pages where accessible (Microsoft Power BI, Metabase, ThoughtSpot, Looker/Google Cloud, Mode, GoodData). Tableau's official pricing page (tableau.com/pricing) returned HTTP 403 on all attempts; prices sourced from GetApp aggregator (corroborated by two independent GetApp fetches). Qlik's official pricing page returned no machine-readable pricing data; Business tier price sourced from GetApp aggregator. Sigma Computing has no published self-serve pricing on its official website; starting price reference sourced from SoftwareAdvice aggregator. All monetaryUsd figures represent the effective per-seat monthly cost at the smallest self-serve unit, billed annually where that is the only published rate. null = quote-only or not self-serve. accessedAt = 2026-06-14 on all sources.

vendors.name: Tableau
vendors.provenance: Official tableau.com/pricing page returned HTTP 403 on all fetch attempts (2026-06-14). Prices sourced from GetApp aggregator at getapp.com/business-intelligence-analytics-software/a/tableau/pricing/ — Viewer $15, Explorer $42, Creator $75 per user per month — corroborated by a second independent GetApp fetch returning identical figures. Annual vs. monthly billing distinction not disclosed on the aggregator page; Tableau historically bills annually but GetApp lists these as monthly rates without qualification.
